app.name: La Quiniela
app.credit: Made by Angelo Chavez and Connoly Chavez

login.title: Enter the pool
login.subtitle: Pick your name and enter the group password.
login.adminHint: The admin (Angelo) uses a separate PIN to enter results.

pot.title: The pot
pot.disclaimer: Informational only. The app does not process payments; settle off-app (Yape / Plin / cash).

about.title: About
about.body: La Quiniela is our World Cup 2026 pool: everyone predicts the matches, correct picks earn points, and the leaderboard rules. It grew out of grandfather's Excel sheet.
about.credit: Made by Angelo Chavez and Connoly Chavez

admin.title: Admin panel
admin.pinSubtitle: Enter the PIN to record results and manage the group.
admin.resultsHint: Mark each match's WINNER (1 / X / 2). The leaderboard updates automatically.
admin.membersHint: Mark who has paid the buy-in.
admin.verifyTimes: Verify kickoff times: they were generated from the official daily slots and may need adjusting.
admin.potSettingsHint: Set the buy-in, currency, points per correct pick, and the payout split.
admin.autoResultsHint: Results update on their own as each match finishes. You can also sync manually.
